info.name: Roswell, New Mexico
info.plot: Dopo essere tornata nella sua città natale di Roswell (Nuovo Messico), la figlia di due persone immigrate e senza documenti scopre che la sua cotta adolescenziale è un alieno che ha tenuto nascoste le sue capacità soprannaturali per tutta la sua vita. Protegge il suo segreto mentre i due si riconnettono, ma quando un attacco violento indica una presenza aliena più grande sulla Terra, la politica della paura e dell'odio minaccia di esporsi.

episodes.name: Alla ricerca della verità

seasons.plot: Season 3 finds Max Evans, and his alien siblings, tasked to uncover the mysterious figure uncovered in the final moments of season 2. Meanwhile, we’ll find our intrepid Liz Ortecho living out her dream job. But a series of events will prove that our one-time lover’s connection might not be severed for good:  a mysterious radio signal begins broadcasting across Roswell; Alex Manes finds himself in the crosshairs of a new clandestine organization; and Michael, Isobel and Rosa all begin exhibiting new powers. Confusing things even further is an eerie glimpse Maria gets of the future.

After reluctantly returning to her tourist-trap hometown of Roswell, New Mexico, the daughter of undocumented immigrants discovers a shocking truth about her teenage crush who is now a police officer—he’s an alien who has kept his unearthly abilities hidden his entire life. She protects his secret as the two reconnect and begin to investigate his origins, but when a violent attack and long-standing government cover-up point to a greater alien presence on Earth, the politics of fear and hatred threaten to expose him and destroy their deepening romance.
